JICA participants enjoyed "Mochitsuki," pounding cooked rice to make "MOCHI" Rice Cakes, on January 21 at the court yard.  Under the instruction of Japanese staff, participants pounding cooked rice with wooden stick in "HAPPI", Japanese traditional work wear. This was their first time to do so, but they did powerfully and wonderfully along with cheering calls "Yoisho, Yoisho" given from surrounding people.
The rice-cake were then cut in pieces by hands, and served with sweet beans paste, soy bean powders, sugar, soy sauce, and strawberry.  Participants enjoyed the traditional japanese delicacy.

JICA沖縄では、去る1月21（月）に新春恒例の”餅つき”を開催しました。法被を身にまとった研修員は、スタッフの指導のもと”よいしょ！、よいしょ！”の掛け声のもと、初めての杵を手に威勢よく餅をつきました。
つかれた餅は、スタッフの手で丸められ、あんこやきなこ、砂糖や醤油、イチゴなどをまぶして食され、日本の伝統的な新春の催しを楽しみました。

title: OIC Participants' 2016 Eisa Performance at URASOE TEDAKO Festival
text:
OIC Participants' 2016 Eisa Performance at URASOE TEDAKO Festival
Under the guidance of the Uranishi Youth Association, 22 JICA OIC participants and some JICA OIC staff practiced the "Eisa"known as Okinawan traditional drum dance for a brief 3 weeks to perform at Tedako festival, which is one of the biggest summer festival in Okinawa on July 24th, 2016. 
On the day of the festival, we showed our performance in public and enjoyed a lot the seasonal traditional summer event in Okinawa.

Performing Eisa for their first time, the participants had some difficulties how to dance,,, But as you see, they performed very well! Through the performance, all participants could deepen their understanding and admiration for Okinawa traditional culture. We hope do a dance together once more some day.

Lastly, we'd like to say to Uranishi Youth Association our gratitude for enduring guidance and dancing together at the festival for our great OIC participants.

浦西青年会による指導のもと、JICA沖縄の研修員22名とJICA沖縄の有志メンバーは、浦添市てだこ祭りで披露するべく3週間の短期間でエイサー技術の習得に励んできました。そして、迎えた本番当日、研修員たちは思い思いにエイサーを演舞し、沖縄の風物詩である夏祭りを精一杯堪能しました。

生まれて初めて体験するエイサーという踊り。慣れずに型を覚えるのに苦労したものの、沖縄の伝統文化に触れ、また一つ沖縄への愛着を深める機会になったと感じ、またまったく不慣れな研修員たちを辛抱強く指導、そして当日も一緒に踊っていただいた浦西青年会の皆様に、改めて御礼申し上げます。ありがとうございました。

title: Estamos conectados por un hilo invisible.
text:
Estamos conectados por un hilo invisible.
En Colombia donde los habitantes son menos de la mitad de la población total de Japón, la cantidad de personas infectadas por el covid-19 ya superó los 500.000 y la cifra de muertos superó los 15.000.
En este país, el ingreso per cápita es solo alrededor de una quinta parte de Japón y la pobreza todavía existe, por esto, las actividades sociales y económicas se están viendo muy afectadas.
Mientras tanto en la sucursal de JICA Colombia, hemos estado trabajando durante 42 años con la gente local para un mejor desarrollo socio-económico.
Como durante todo este tiempo hemos compartido nuestras aspiraciones, se ha establecido una relación que se puede definir con una sola palabra ¨amistad¨
Debido a esa situación, decidimos actuar como amigos que somos, asi nos encontremos lejos este titulo no os lo quita nadie, por eso decidimos hacer este video, para brindarles un cálido apoyo.
Esperamos que lo disfruten.

日本の総人口の半分にも満たない南米コロンビアでは、コロナウィルス累計感染者がすでに70万人を超え、死者は2万2千人を超えています。
国民一人当たりの所得が日本の5分の1程度に過ぎない当国では、未だ貧困に喘いでいる状況でありながら、社会的経済的活動に大きな影響が出ています。
そんな中JICAコロンビア支所では、42年間現地の人々と手を携えて社会経済の開発を進めて、志を共にしてきたなかで「友達」と言える関係が出来上がりました。
今この状況下だからこそ、私たちはこの遠い親友の「日本人という親友」への思いを受け止め、温かい支援の手を差し伸べたいという思いから、本動画の制作に至りました。
本動画について、少しでも興味を持って共感いただけましたら幸いです。

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　              コロンビア支所長

title: 【Introduction】Clinica  (MonJa Selected Startup)(English)
text:
【Introduction】Clinica  (MonJa Selected Startup)(English)
Mongolia, which has nearly four times the total area of Japan, is home to many nomad people, and medical access is a serious issue, particularly in rural areas. Even in Ulaanbaatar, the capital city, it can take up to 20 days or longer for a patient to be diagnosed by a doctor after visiting the hospital. Clinica is working on an online telemedicine app that will allow people to get a doctor's diagnosis without having to wait anywhere. Also, in the near future, they aim to provide efficient and effective medical services using artificial intelligence (AI).

title: MonJa хөтөлбөрийн оролцогч Багшийн туслах компанийн танилцуулга. Монгол хэлээр.
text:

Монголд хот хөдөөгийн ялгаа, ядуурал нэмэгдэж байгаатай холбоотой боловсролын чанарт ч зөрүү гарсаар байна. Мөн COVID 19-ийн нөлөөгөөр сургуулиуд  цахимаар хичээллэж байгаатай холбоотой хүүхдүүд боловсролын үйлчилгээг бүрэн дүүрэн авч чадахгүйд хүрч байна. Тус компани боловсролын зөрүүг арилгах, коронавирусын үед боловсролын хүртээмжийг дээшлүүлэх зорилгоор ерөнхий боловсролын сургуульд хамрагдаж байгаа бага, дунд ахлах ангийн сурагчдад бага зардлаар чанартай боловсролыг онлайнаар холбогдон авч болох контентийг боловсруулж, платформ хэлбэрээр түгээж байна.

title: JICA's project introduction in the field of veterinary
text:
JICA's project introduction in the field of veterinary
In Mongolia, the technical level of veterinarians is low, so it is not possible to fully meet the needs for livestock breeding and livestock disease control. Therefore, from April 2014 to May 2020, "The Project for Strengthening the Capacity for Human Resource Development in the Field of Veterinary and Animal Husbandry" was implemented to strengthen the capabilities of School of Veterinary Medicine. This School plays a central role in human resource development for veterinarians in Mongolia. By implementing this project, the curriculum of the school of veterinary medicine was improved, and the education implementation system was improved in line with the curriculum, and the teaching ability of teachers was strengthened. Since there is an urgent need to improve the practical abilities of public and private veterinarians who are active in the field, the "Project for Strengthening the Practical Capacity of Public and Private Veterinarian" started in June 2020 as Phase 2.

title: Video CEP(Programa de empoderamiento comunitario) Fundacion REI y JICA-Colombia
text:
Video CEP(Programa de empoderamiento comunitario) Fundacion REI y JICA-Colombia
La llegada del COVID-19 a Colombia sin lugar a duda marcó un cambio sin precedentes en todos los sectores sociales y económicos en el país.  Sin embargo, en esta pandemia, una de las poblaciones que se vieron más vulnerables son las personas con discapacidad y sus familiares, esto debido a las alteraciones de los servicios de salud y de redes de apoyo. 

Fundación REI, quien ha venido trabajando desde hace 47 años en la ciudad de Cartagena con personas con discapacidad en la modalidad de educación especial, identificó al principio de la pandemia a través de sus aulas virtuales que los alumnos se encontraban en condiciones de alta vulnerabilidad y riesgo social, enfrentando dificultades en sus contextos familiares como: falta de personas quién los cuide, padres y madres desempleados, necesidades básicas insatisfechas, entre otros.  

En este contexto se desarrolló entre la Agencia de cooperación Internacional del Japón (JICA) y la Fundación REI un Proyecto Social con el fin de adelantar una investigación para estimar las afectaciones de la nueva pandemia COVID-19, en las familias con personas con discapacidad, con el fin de analizar apoyos eficientes a esta población. 

Dentro de la investigación se brindaron apoyos económicos a través de mercados a las 300 familias focalizadas en el proyecto, talleres de capacitación, asistencia psicológica y materiales de capacitación para sus hijas o hijos con discapacidad.

title: VersionⅡ,JICA-Colombia, we want some way to transmit the living voices of the victims of conflicts
text:
VersionⅡ,JICA-Colombia, we want some way to transmit the living voices of the victims of conflicts
I think one of the important perspectives on peacebuilding in Colombia is not to forget the experiences and feelings of the victims of conflict, facing them in history, and to pave the way for reconciliation. 

 JICA has continued to support victims through technical cooperation for the peacebuilding process promoted by the Colombian people and the Colombian government, and its policy will not change in the future.

 On the other hand, JICA is the executing agency for Japan's Official Development Assistance, and the understanding of the Japanese people is essential for continuing cooperation on the issue. Therefore, as a premise, I think it is necessary to convey properly the voices of the victims of the conflict to the Japanese people. 

 JICA Colombia is trying to translate two books published by the Medellín Municipal Office that compile the live voices of the victims of conflicts in Antioquia and around Medellín into Japanese and convey it to the people in Japan and the world who are friends and great supporters of the Colombian people. This time, I would like to share the outline of our activities with you.

MSc.Naoki Kamijo      Resident Representative of JICA Colombia

title: JICA-Colombia, queremos alguna manera transmitir las vivas voces de las victimas conflictos
text:
JICA-Colombia, queremos alguna manera transmitir las vivas voces de las victimas conflictos
Uno de los puntos de vista importantes para la construcción de la paz en Colombia es no olvidar las vivencias y pensamientos de las víctimas del conflicto, enfrentarlo como historia y camino para la reconciliación.
JICA continúa apoyando a las víctimas del conflicto a través de proyectos de cooperación técnica en el proceso de la construcción de la paz impulsado por el pueblo colombiano y el gobierno colombiano, y nuestra política no cambiará en el futuro.
Por otro lado, como JICA es la agencia ejecutora de la AOD (Ayuda Oficial para el Desarrollo) de Japón, el apoyo del pueblo japonés es esencial para la continuación de nuestros proyectos. Por lo tanto, como premisa, creo que es necesario transmitir adecuadamente las vivas voces de las víctimas del conflicto al pueblo japonés.
En JICA Colombia, estamos tratando de traducir al japonés los libros que recopilan las vivas voces de las víctimas del conflicto armado y violencia en Antioquia y Medellín, compilados por la alcaldía de Medellín, con el fin de compartirlas con el pueblo japonés, amigo del pueblo colombiano.  
Me gustaría que ustedes se enteren de nuestro granito de arena para contribuir al tema de la paz en Colombia 
 
Representante Residente  de JICA Colombia        Naoki   Kamijo

title: Simpósio: Educação de Língua Japonesa
text:
Simpósio: Educação de Língua Japonesa
A mudança das gerações de sociedade nikkei do Brasil vem provocando a redução dos membros de associações Bunkyo e também dos alunos das escolas japonesas tradicionais. Hoje em dia, a educação da língua japonesa não se limita apenas no ensino tradicional que visa a sucessão da cultura tradicional, devido ao aumento da variação das demandas do ensino, como o ensino de língua para os não-descendentes e para os futuros dekasseguis e viajantes. Dentro do contexto de pandemia que dificultou as administrações das escolas e aulas da língua japonesa, este simpósio foi planejado com o objetivo de oferecer a oportunidade de pensarmos sobre o futuro ensino da língua japonesa e gestão escolar com uma visão mais ampla e diversificada.
O simpósio apresenta duas partes de painéis de discussão, com a participação dos moderadores e panelistas, atuantes no ambiente de ensino da língua japonesa e entidades nikkeis. Na primeira parte, sobre o tema “Importância da prática do ensino da língua japonesa”, foram apresentados as situações e motivações dos professores, junto com o ponto de vista do gestor que implementa o ensino da língua japonesa no Brasil. Na segunda parte, sobre o tema "Gestão estratégica das escolas de língua japonesa", foram apresentados os  exemplos reais de gestão, esclarecimento da divisão de funções entre coordenadores e professores, e também sobre a importância da cooperação com federações regionais e Bunkyos no ensino da língua.

title: JICA's Volunteer Activities in India (2017)  - Long Version
text:
JICA's Volunteer Activities in India (2017)  - Long Version
JICA's volunteer programs support activities by citizens who wish to cooperate in the economic and social development as well as the reconstruction of developing countries. Through these cooperation activities, participating volunteers can not only contribute to the development of partner countries but also gain valuable experience in terms of international goodwill, mutual understanding and an expansion in their international perspectives.
In India, the program started in 1966 and to this date, over 200 volunteers have been dispatched across India, in the field of Education, Community Development, and Sports, etc.  In this video,  2 volunteers of Japanese Language Education and Community Development talk about their activities and their counterparts respectively share their experience of having a volunteer at their places.

text:
Lancement des travaux de construction du Centre Sportif de Judo : Mot du Représentant de la JICA RDC
Le discours de Mr Kazunao SHIBATA, Représentant Résident de la JICA RDC le 15 mai 2021 lors du lancement officiel des travaux de construction du Centre Sportif de Judo à Kinshasa, RDC.

La cérémonie a été tenu au Commissariat Général de la Police Nationale Congolaise (PNC) par Son Excellence Monsieur Jean Claude MOLIPE, Vice-Ministre de l’Intérieur, Sécurité, Décentralisation et Affaires Coutumières en présence de Son Excellence Monsieur Hiroyuki MINAMI, Ambassadeur du Japon en RDC, du Général AMULI BAHIGWA Dieudonné, Commissaire Générale de la PNC, de Mr Kazunao SHIBATA, Représentant Résident de la JICA en RDC et tant d’autres autorités politico administratif et officiers de la PNC. 

Cette infrastructure financée grâce à un don non remboursable du gouvernement japonais à hauteur de JPY 1.395.000.000 soit environ 13.000.000 USD aura une capacité de 780 places assises avec un aréna (pour judo, karaté, basketball, volleyball), salle de fitness etc. Ce projet d’infrastructure sportif sera érigé dans l’enceinte du Commissariat Général de la PNC à Kinshasa jusqu’en juin 2022. Elle sera accessible à toute la population dans l’optique de promouvoir les activités sportives centrées sur les arts martiaux tels que le judo et de favoriser l’encadrement et un développent sain de la jeunesse congolaise, en vue d’approfondir l’approche Police de Proximité, axe central de la PNC.

title: Remise des tests de diagnostic rapide pour la Maladie à Virus Ebola
text:
Remise des tests de diagnostic rapide pour la Maladie à Virus Ebola
Remise de 1.000 tests de diagnostic rapide d'Ebola de la JICA à l'INRB
エボラ迅速検査キットをコンゴ民主共和国の研究所に贈呈しました。

Dans le cadre de l’appui à l’urgence de l’épidémie de la Maladie à Virus Ebola en province de l'Equateur et du Projet de Recherche Epidémiologique sur les Infections Virales Zoonotiques en Afrique (SATREPS), Mr Kazunao SHIBATA, Représentant Résident de la JICA, a procédé ce 31 juillet 2020 à la remise des kits de 1.000 tests de diagnostic rapide QuickNavi-Ebola au Professeur Jean-Jacques MUYEMBE, Directeur Général de l’INRB. Ces kits de diagnostic mis au point par Professeur Ayato TAKADA ont été offerts par la société japonaise Denka Seiken et l’Université d’Hokkaïdo du Japon. C’est depuis la survenue de l’épidémie Ebola de Likati que Denka Seiken, l’Université d’Hokkaïdo et la JICA apportent ce type d’appui à l’INRB. Par ailleurs, la JICA accompagne le Comité Multisectoriel de Riposte Covid-19 dans la lutte contre l’épidémie de la Covid-19 en RDC à travers un appui technique et matériel.

title: Mine Action for Peace: Rise of CMAC as Major Partner of South-South Cooperation and JICA's Role
text:
Mine Action for Peace: Rise of CMAC as Major Partner of South-South Cooperation and JICA's Role
Landmine is a serious threat to humanity, which hinders safety of people, peace of society, and collective sustainable development efforts of the world. 
Based on this recognition, for more than 20 years, JICA has been working closely with the Cambodian Mine Action Centre (CMAC) to build their institutional capacity to achieve safety and peace for the people of Cambodia. 
As a result, CMAC has risen to utilize its strengthened mine action capacity not only in Cambodia but also internationally in other contaminated countries, such as Laos and Colombia through South-South cooperation facilitated by JICA. 
South-South cooperation in mine action not only transfers knowledge and skills but also delivers hope for a safe and peaceful future, as well as vision for a mine-free world.

パラグアイへの日本人ボランティア派遣は１９７８年に始まり、今年、４０周年を迎えます。

これまでに、１,６００人以上の青年海外協力隊及びシニア海外ボランティア（日系社会青年・シニアボランティアを含む）がこの国に派遣され、技術移転のみならず、日本とパラグアイ両国の親善と文化交流の促進に大きく貢献して来ました。

パラグアイへのボランティア派遣４０周年を記念し、本年１０月頃ボまでを目途にランティアの現地での活動や生活、技術等、４０周年特集記事をお届け致します。

title: Actividad Domótica
text:
Actividad Domótica
Un voluntario Senior que actualmente está trabajando en el área de Domótica en el Paraguay, notó la falta de un timbre automatizado en la institución dónde trabaja. Por ello, creó uno para una mejor organización en cada espacio que hay de enseñanza.

パラグアイ首都圏の職業能力促進センターにて電気・電子機器の職種で活動しているシニア海外ボランティアが、これまで配属先の関係者と進めてきた開発研究の成果を、簡単にまとめたビデオを紹介します。
配属先はこれまで手動でベルを鳴らしていましたが、学校運営の効率化のため、自動ベルも制作しました。
任期も残りわずかですが、これまでの成果が認められたため、配属先は任期満了後も同シニア海外ボランティアをセンターの職員として一定期間雇用することも検討しているそうです。

title: Хүүхдүүдээ хамтдаа гараа угаацгаая!
text:
Хүүхдүүдээ хамтдаа гараа угаацгаая!
Ковид-19-ийн нөлөөгөөр хүүхдүүдтэйгээ хамт илүү олон удаа гараа угаадаг болж байна уу? Жайка-н төслийн хүрээнд хүүхдүүдэд гар угаах ач холбогдол болон, үр дүнтэй гараа угаах талаар тайлбарлан анимэ хэлбэрээр та бүхэнд хүргэж байна. Энэхүү видеог Боловсрол соёл шинжлэх ухааны яамнаас бэлтгэн гаргаж буй теле хичээлийн өмнө ба хойно цацахаар төлөвлөж байгаа ба багш сурган хүмүүжүүлэгч болон эцэг эхчүүд та бүхэн мөн хүүхдүүдтэйгээ видеогоо хамт үзэн вирусийн халдвараас сэргийлээрэй. 
Тус видео нь Жайка-н Эрүүл мэнд, амь насаа хамгаалахын тулд гараа угаацгаая аяны хүрээнд Иноүэ Кимидоригийн Гараа зөв угаах дадал зурагт номноос сэдэвлэсэн бүтээл юм.
COVID-19の影響で、子どもたちと一緒に手洗いをすることが増えたのではないでしょうか。プロジェクトでは子どもたちに手洗いの大切さ、効果的な手洗いの方法を説明したアニメーション動画を作成しました。この動画は、教育省のTV授業の前後でも放送される予定です。先生方や保護者の皆さんもぜひお子さんと一緒に見て、ウィルスから体を守りましょう！（JICA健康と命のための手洗い運動キャンペーンの一環として制作された井上きみどりさんの「正しい手洗い漫画」をもとに作成しました。）

title: Монгол Улсын Үндэсний хөгжлийн цогц төлөвлөгөө
text:
Монгол Улсын Үндэсний хөгжлийн цогц төлөвлөгөө
ЖАЙКА нь 2019 оноос Барилга, Хот Байгуулалтын Яам болон Үндэсний Хөгжлийн Газартай хамтран “Үндэсний хөгжлийн цогц төлөвлөгөө боловсруулах төсөл”-ийг хэрэгжүүлж байна. Үндэсний хөгжлийн цогц төлөвлөгөөг боловсруулснаар эдийн засгийн үйл ажиллагаа болон экспортыг төрөлжүүлэх, байгаль орчныг хамгаалах, мөн орон нутгийн үйлдвэрлэлийг дэмжих замаар орон нутгийн бие даасан хөгжлийг хангах, улсын тэнцвэртэй бөгөөд хүртээмжтэй хөгжлийг цогцлооход дэмжлэг үзүүлнэ.

Энэхүү төслийн үйл ажиллагааны талаарх танилцуулга видеог Youtube-д байршуулсан тул та бүхэн доорх линкээр орж үзэж сонирхоно уу.

text:

Японы Олон улсын хамтын ажиллагааны байгууллагын техникийн туслалцааны хүрээнд хэрэгжүүлж буй “Үндэсний хөгжлийн цогц төлөвлөгөө боловсруулах” төслийн баг нь Монгол Улсын залуусыг
2020 оны 8 дугаар сарын 17-ны өдөр зохион байгуулагдах Залуучуудын төлөөллийг оролцуулсан Оролцогч талуудын нэгдсэн хурал болон
9 дүгээр сарын эхээр зохион байгуулагдах онлайн хэлэлцүүлэгт тус тус боллоо.
Уг төсөл нь Монгол болон Япон улсын Засгийн газар хооронд байгуулсан гэрээний дагуу 2018 оны 12-р сараас хэрэгжиж эхэлсэн болно.
Бидний зорилго бол хот, хөдөөгийн ялгаатай байдлыг бууруулан, тэнцвэртэй, тогтвортой хөгжлийг дэмжих замаар хот суурин газарт тулгарч буй асуудлыг шийдвэрлэж Монгол Улсын тогтвортой хөгжлийг (2020-2040 он) хангах явдал юм.

この動画を見てください。これは、JICA青年海外協力隊たちが、モンゴル各地でごみ拾いをした様子です。私たちJICA海外協力隊もモンゴルの方と同じように、この美しい自然や町を大切にしたいと願っています。また、モンゴル国の宝である家畜を汚染から守りたいとも考えています。しかし、ご覧の通りモンゴルの町にはたくさんのごみが落ちています。  また、ごみ問題は、世界共通の課題です。だから、他国で活動するJICA海外協力隊の仲間にも、この取り組みが広がってほしいと願っています。

title: Халдварт өвчнөөс урдчилан сэргийлцгээе!
text:
Халдварт өвчнөөс урдчилан сэргийлцгээе!
Хүүхдүүдэд гараа зөв угаах, хоолойгоо зөв зайлах арга, ач холбогдолыг танилцуулах, хэвшүүлэх зорилгоор бичлэг хийсэн тул та бүхэн сонирхож үзээрэй. Дэлхий нийтээрээ шинэ төрлийн коронавирусын халдварт санаа зовнин буй үед энэ бичлэг олон хүнд хүрч, хүүхдүүд гараа зөв угааж, хоолойгоо зөв зайлж сурна гэдэгт найдаж байна. Мөн, энэ бичлэг танд таалагдвал бусдад түгээхийг хичээнгүйлэн хүсье.

text:

title: DPUB 5 дахь Онлайн хичээл “Хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй иргэдийн төлөөх Үндэсний зөвлөл”-ийн үйл ажиллагаа”
text:
DPUB 5 дахь Онлайн хичээл “Хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй иргэдийн төлөөх Үндэсний зөвлөл”-ийн үйл ажиллагаа”
М.Баясгалан нь 2005-2013 он хүртэл Монголын Хараагүйчүүдийн Үндэсний холбооны тэргүүнээр ажиллаж байсан.
Тэрээр 2015 онд “Хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй иргэдийн төлөөх Үндэсний зөвлөл”
ТББ-ыг үүсгэн байгуулсан бөгөөд ХБИ-ийн хөдөлгөөнийг удирдаж ирсэн хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй манлайлагчдын нэг юм. Энэ удаагийн ярилцлагаар Баясгалантай өнөөгийн үйл ажиллагаа болон тулгамдаж байгаа асуудал, Хүртээмжийн тухай хуулийн талаар мэдээлэл солилцлоо.

title: DPUB 4 дэх онлайн хичээл "Монгол Улсын ТББ-уудын үйл ажиллагаа. Түгээмэл хөгжил бие даан амьдрах төв
text:
DPUB 4 дэх онлайн хичээл "Монгол Улсын ТББ-уудын үйл ажиллагаа. Түгээмэл хөгжил бие даан амьдрах төв
Монгол Улсад ХБИ-ийн салбарт үйл ажиллагаа явуулдаг ТББ-ууд олон байдаг. Эдгээрийн дотор Японы ХБИ-ийн бие даан амьдрах үйл ажиллагаанаас суралцаад ирсэн Ундрахбаярын үүсгэн байгуулсан "Түгээмэл хөгжил" бие даан амьдрах төв нь ХБИ-ийн нийгмийн оролцоог дэмжин маш идэвхтэй үйл ажиллагаа явуулдаг. Ундрахбаяр хэрхэн анх Монголд бие даан амьдрах төв байгуулсан бэ? Энэ удаагийн хичээлээр түүний амьдрал болон бие даан амьдрах төв байгуулсан учир шалтгааны талаар тодруулах болно.

title: No.1 Хөгжлийн бэрхшээл гэж юу вэ?БМДИ-ийн онлайн сургалт Тэгш хамруулан сургах боловсрол
text:
No.1 Хөгжлийн бэрхшээл гэж юу вэ?БМДИ-ийн онлайн сургалт Тэгш хамруулан сургах боловсрол
Боловсрол, Соёл, Шинжлэх Ухаан, Спортын яам, Хөдөлмөр, Нийгмийн Хамгааллын Яамтай хамтран 2015 оны 8-р сараас хэрэгжүүлж буй ЖАЙКА –ийн “Тусгай хэрэгцээт боловсрол шаардлагатай хүүхдэд үзүүлэх эрүүл мэнд, боловсрол, нийгмийн хамгааллын үйлчилгээг сайжруулах төсөл” нь хөгжлийн хоцрогдол, бэрхшээлтэй хүүхдэд хөгжлийн дэмжлэг үзүүлэх, боловсролын үйлчилгээнд хамруулах, сургуульд нээлттэй хүлээж авах тогтолцоог бүрдүүлэхэд чиглэсэн үйл ажиллагаануудыг явуулж байна . Хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй хүүхдийг сургуульд хүлээж авах тогтолцоог бий болгох зорилгоор туршилтын 14 сургуультай хамтран, “Ганцаарчилсан сургалтын төлөвлөгөө” боловсруулах, багшлах арга зүйг сайжруулах, хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй хүүхдэд тохирох хэрэглэгдэхүүн бүхий орчинг бүрдүүлэх зэрэг үйл ажиллагааг хэрэгжүүлж байна.  
Туршилтын сургуулиуд дээр хэрэгжүүлсэн хийгдсэн үйл ажиллагаа, сургалтууд дээр үндэслэн, холбогдох багш, мэргэжилтнүүдэд видео хичээлээр дамжуулан тэгш хамруулан сургах боловсролын талаар нэгдсэн ойлголтыг бүрдүүлэх, мэдлэгийг сайжруулах зорилгоор “Тэгш хамруулан сургах боловсрол” нэртэй цуврал онлайн видео хичээлийг дохионы хэлний хөрвүүлэгтэйгээр боловсруулав. Эдгээр хичээлүүдийг үзээд мэдлэгээ бататгах үүднээс өөрийгөө шалгах 3 багц тестийг бэлтгэсэн болно.

Боловсрол, Соёл, Шинжлэх Ухаан, Спортын яам, Хөдөлмөр, Нийгмийн Хамгааллын Яамтай хамтран 2015 оны 8-р сараас хэрэгжүүлж буй ЖАЙКА –ийн “Тусгай хэрэгцээт боловсрол шаардлагатай хүүхдэд үзүүлэх эрүүл мэнд, боловсрол, нийгмийн хамгааллын үйлчилгээг сайжруулах төсөл” нь хөгжлийн хоцрогдол, бэрхшээлтэй хүүхдэд хөгжлийн дэмжлэг үзүүлэх, боловсролын үйлчилгээнд хамруулах, сургуульд нээлттэй хүлээж авах тогтолцоог бүрдүүлэхэд чиглэсэн үйл ажиллагаануудыг явуулж байна . Хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй хүүхдийг сургуульд хүлээж авах тогтолцоог бий болгох зорилгоор туршилтын 14 сургуультай хамтран, “Ганцаарчилсан сургалтын төлөвлөгөө” боловсруулах, багшлах арга зүйг сайжруулах, хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй хүүхдэд тохирох хэрэглэгдэхүүн бүхий орчинг бүрдүүлэх зэрэг үйл ажиллагааг хэрэгжүүлж байна.  
Туршилтын сургуулиуд дээр хэрэгжүүлсэн хийгдсэн үйл ажиллагаа, сургалтууд дээр үндэслэн, холбогдох багш, мэргэжилтнүүдэд видео хичээлээр дамжуулан тэгш хамруулан сургах боловсролын талаар нэгдсэн ойлголтыг бүрдүүлэх, мэдлэгийг сайжруулах зорилгоор “Тэгш хамруулан сургах боловсрол” нэртэй цуврал онлайн видео хичээлийг дохионы хэлний хөрвүүлэгтэйгээр боловсруулав. Эдгээр хичээлүүдийг үзээд мэдлэгээ бататгах үүднээс өөрийгөө шалгах 3 багц тестийг бэлтгэсэн болно.

title: "Хүүхэд бүрт тэгш боломж" Монгол хадмалтай
text:
"Хүүхэд бүрт тэгш боломж" Монгол хадмалтай
Монгол Улсын Боловсрол, соёл, шинжлэх ухаан, спортын яам, Хөдөлмөр, нийгмийн хамгааллын яам, Японы олон улсын хамтын ажиллагааны байгууллага /ЖАЙКА/ хамтран хэрэгжүүлж буй “Тусгай хэрэгцээт боловсрол шаардлагатай хүүхдэд үзүүлэх эрүүл мэнд, боловсрол, нийгмийн хамгааллын үйлчилгээг сайжруулах төсөл” (2015-2019 он) нь хөгжлийн хоцрогдол бэрхшээлтэй хүүхдэд хөгжлийн дэмжлэг үзүүлэх, тэднийг боловсролын үйлчилгээнд тэгш хамруулан сургах нийгмийг цогцлоон бүтээх үйлсэд дэмжлэг туслалцаа үзүүлж байна. 
Жил бүрийн 12-р сарын 3-ны “Хөгжлийн бэрхшээлтэй иргэдийн эрхийг хамгаалах олон улсын өдөр”-ийг тохиолдуулан,  та бүхэндээ Ховд аймгийн 7-р дунд сургуульд суралцдаг Ө.Жавзан охины амьдрал, сургууль,гэртээ өнгөрүүлж буй аж байдлын тухай хүргэж байна. 7-р дунд сургууль ЖАЙКА төслийн дэмжлэгтэйгээр өөрийн сургуульд суралцдаг ХБХ-ийн боловсролыг дэмжих төслийг 2017.10-2018.06 сар хүртэлх хугацаанд хэрэгжүүлээд байна.  
JICA障害児のための教育改善プロジェクト（2015-2019）は、教育文化科学スポーツ省および労働・社会保障省とともに、発達の遅れや偏りのある子どもを支援し、インクルーシブな社会づくりを応援しています。
12月3日の国際障害者の日を記念し、ホブド県第7学校に通うジャブザンさんの学校や家庭での様子をお伝えします。ホブド県第7学校は、JICAプロジェクトの協力を受けて、2017年10月～2018年6月まで、同行に通う障害のある子どもたちへの教育支援プロジェクトを実施しました。（本編はモンゴル語のみとなっております）

title: 50º aniversário do Programa de Treinamento para Comunidade Nikkei da JICA (legendado em português)
text:
50º aniversário do Programa de Treinamento para Comunidade Nikkei da JICA (legendado em português)
A JICA vem oferecendo o Programa de Treinamento para Comunidade Nikkei para pessoas que desempenham papéis de liderança na cooperação entre o Japão e as comunidades nikkeis da América Latina.
O Programa de Treinamento para Comunidade Nikkei teve início em 1971 e acaba de completar meio século de existência. Uma cerimônia foi realizada no Brasil em comemoração ao aniversário do programa.

title: Inmigración japonesa a Brasil
text:
Inmigración japonesa a Brasil
Hace 100 años, un buque llamado "Kasatomaru" llegó al Puerto Santos en Brasil con la primera inmigración japonesa en ese país. Cabe señalar que la primera inmigración japonesa al Perú fue hace 120 años. Después de muchas dificultades y ezfuerzos, la sociedad japonesa creció en Brasil y en muchos países de Latinoamérica. Esto ha generado que se establezcan buenas relaciones entre los países de Latinoamerica el Japón.

Compartimos un videl sobre esta historia.

title: Distribución de Artículos de Ayuda Humanitaria de Japón
text:
Distribución de Artículos de Ayuda Humanitaria de Japón
-A principios de mayo JICA acompañó a funcionarios del Gobierno Regional de Piura para distribuir los artículos de ayuda humanitaria que donó Japón para los damnificados afectados por lluvias e inundaciones en dicha región. Entregamos purificadores de agua a los Centros Poblados de Punta Arenas, Progreso Bajo y Santa Ana; así como un generador de electricidad al Centro Poblado de El Carmen en el Distrito de Tambo Grande en la Provincia de Piura. Asimismo entregamos carpas, colchonetas, purificadores de agua y generadores de electricidad a los alberques del Distrito de Cura Mori de la Provincia de Piura, donde viven miles de familias que necesitan ayuda humanitaria.

title: JICA - Video de Monitoreo de Utilización de Artículos de Ayuda Humanitaria de Japón
text:
JICA - Video de Monitoreo de Utilización de Artículos de Ayuda Humanitaria de Japón
A finales del mes de Mayo, personal de JICA Perú se dirigió a la región de Piura para realizar un monitoreo de utilización de artículos de Ayuda Humanitaria que fueron donados por Japón. En el video se puede apreciar la visita a escuelas y albergues de distritos como Catacaos y Cura Mori, donde se hace uso del material recibido por los pobladores damnificados.  Entre estas donaciones se encuentran  carpas, colchonetas, frazadas,  Purificadores de agua y Generadores de electricidad.
Asimismo, en el video se puede apreciar el agradecimiento de damnificados y alumnado por el material donado, el cual ha sido de gran ayuda para superar los momentos difíciles que ha tenido que enfrentar la población por el último Fenómeno del Niño acontecido.

title: JICA NGO Desk Training On Furoshiki As Eco-Friendly Shopping Bag
text:
JICA NGO Desk Training On Furoshiki As Eco-Friendly Shopping Bag
JICA Indonesia held an online training with the title “FUROSHIKI as eco-friendly shopping bag” which aimed to develop NGO Desk’s partner in capacity building to reach grassroot level on environment or waste management.

This online training has successfully attracted the attention and enthusiasm of the participants. During 2 hours and a half, all participants not only got a knowledge in Furoshiki as an art itself. Furthermore, Ms. Arumsari Nugroho shared knowledge about why should have an action for taking care the Earth from waste, introduce Furoshiki as part of environment caring campaign, and of course train participants skill in making Furoshiki for supporting daily needs. 

==

JICA Indonesia mengadakan pelatihan online berjudul “FUROSHIKI sebagai Tas Belanja Ramah Lingkungan” yang bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kapasitas mitra NGO Desk di level akar rumput dalam hal manajemen lingkungan atau sampah.

Pelatihan online ini berhasil menarik perhatian dan antusiasme para peserta. Selama 2 setengah jam, semua peserta tidak hanya mendapatkan ilmu Furoshiki sebagai seni itu sendiri. Lebih lanjut, Ibu Arumsari Nugroho berbagi ilmu tentang mengapa harus ada tindakan menjaga Bumi dari sampah, memperkenalkan Furoshiki sebagai bagian dari kampanye peduli lingkungan, dan tentunya melatih keterampilan peserta dalam membuat Furoshiki untuk menunjang kebutuhan sehari-hari.

title: Mengenang Satu Tahun Bencana Sulawesi Selatan/Remembering One Year Central Sulawesi Selatan
text:
Mengenang Satu Tahun Bencana Sulawesi Selatan/Remembering One Year Central Sulawesi Selatan
Telah genap setahun sejak terjadinya bencana alam yang menimpa saudara-saudara kita di Palu, Sigi, dan  Donggala Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah, dan masih banyak diantara mereka yang masih dalam upaya pemulihan. 

++One year after the disaster that occurred in Palu, Sigi, and Donggala in Central Sulawesi Province, and our friends there are still in the road of recovery. 

Di sepanjang tahun 2019, JICA dibantu dengan pemerintah daerah, lembaga-lembaga non-profit , serta yang lainnya, menyelenggarakan beragam kegiatan yang bertujuan untuk pemulihan trauma sekaligus pendidikan mitigasi bencana bagi saudara-saudara kita tersebut. 

++Throughout 2019, JICA in collaboration with local government, NGOs and other stakeholders, held a series of events that aimed for trauma healing and as well as disaster mitigation education for our friends in the affected areas.

title: Kick Off to the Future
text:
Kick Off to the Future
JICA bekerjasama  dengan Liga Sepak Bola Profesional Jepang (J League) dan Urawa Red Diamonds mendatangkan Seiichiro Maki, mantan pesepakbola profesional Jepang yang juga pernah menjadi bagian dari tim nacional Jepang pada Piala Dunia tahun 2006, untuk acara ‘Kick Off to the Future’ yang diadakan di sebuah lapangan sepak bola di wilayah Kabupaten Sigi, Sulawesi Tengah.

Mari ikuti perjalanannya untuk kegiatan yang bertujuan untuk pemulihan trauma dan edukasi mengenai bencana khususnya untuk anak-anak yang sampai dengan saat ini masih berada di lokasi-lokasi pengungsian.

title: JICA Hadir di Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019 -- JICA in Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019
text:
JICA Hadir di Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019 -- JICA in Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019
-English follows Bahasa Indonesia-

Pada Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019 yang berlangsung di Jakarta, 7 & 8 September 2019, JICA hadir dengan mengusung tema ‘Build Back Better’. 

Booth JICA menampilkan beragam informasi yang berkaitan dengan tema tersebut, permainan tembak-tembakan bertemakan tanda bencana, serta yang lainnya, dengan harapan para pengunjung yang datang ke booth JICA memahami pentingnya pengelolaan bencana dan konsep ‘Build Back Better’ .

Selain itu, 8 September 2019, di booth JICA diadakan talk-show untuk mengedukasi pengunjung terhadap bencana yang terjadi di Sulawesi Tengah, akhir September 2018, yang menghadirkan juga musisi Hiroaki Kato.

==

At the Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019, which took place in Jakarta on 7 & 8 September 2019, JICA introduced the concept of ‘Build Back Better’. 

JICA booth displayed various information related to the theme, a shooting game with ‘Disaster Information Signs’ theme, etc, so by visiting JICA booth, the visitors were expected to understand the importance of disaster management and the concept of ‘Build Back Better’.

Then, on 8 September 2019, JICA held a mini talk-show to disseminate information in relation with the disaster occurred in Central Sulawesi in September 2018, which also participated by musician Hiroaki Kato.

title: BERSAMA MEMBANGUN KEMBALI SULAWESI TENGAH/ BUILD BACK CENTRAL SULAWESI
text:
BERSAMA MEMBANGUN KEMBALI SULAWESI TENGAH/ BUILD BACK CENTRAL SULAWESI
Setelah gempa bumi berkekuatan 7,4M diikuti dengan tsunami, dan likuifaksi terjadi di Kota Palu, dan sekitarnya pada 28 September 2018, JICA menyediakan bantuan tanggap darurat serta mengirimkan tim untuk melakukan penelaahan kondisi lapangan pada area yang terkena dampak bencana. Setelah itu, BAPPENAS menyusun Rencana Induk (Master Plan) pemulihan 
dan pembangunan kembali Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah paska bencana dengan dukungan dari JICA, yang ditindak lanjuti dengan pendampingan dengan konsep Build Back Better.

Dont forget to Like, Comment, Subscribe, and Share!

==

After the 7.4M earthquake followed by a tsunami, and liquefaction occurred in Palu City and its surrounding cities on 28 September 2018, JICA provided emergency response assistance and dispatched a field survey team to the affected areas. After that, BAPPENAS drafted a Master Plan for the rehabilitation and reconstruction of Central Sulawesi Province with support from JICA, which was followed by cooperation with Build Back Better concept.

title: Ep. 5: Towards an Open Asia: Contribution to the International Community (English)
text:
Ep. 5: Towards an Open Asia: Contribution to the International Community (English)
Indonesia is now within reach of joining upper-middle income countries. JICA is actively supporting Indonesia in enhancing the country’s capacities to address challenges of Asia and the international community.

In this episode we will look at JICA’s cooperation in response to global issues such as environmental issues and infectious diseases; the security of Southeast Asia such as maritime safety and cybersecurity; and South-South and Triangular Cooperation in which Indonesia and Japan together provides assistance to other developing countries.

Let's take a look at each and stay tuned for the upcoming videos!

title: Ep. 4: Menurunkan Kesenjangan dan Mewujudkan Keamanan Masyarakat (Bahasa Indonesia)
text:
Ep. 4: Menurunkan Kesenjangan dan Mewujudkan Keamanan Masyarakat (Bahasa Indonesia)
JICA telah  terlibat dalam berbagai proyek untuk mendukung pembangunan sosial dan ekonomi Indonesia.

Ketika berbicara tentang kerja sama ekonomi dengan Jepang, barangkali kesan pertama yang kuat adalah bahwa kerjasama di sektor infrastruktur saja. Namun, sebenarnya kerja sama Jepang untuk mengurangi kesenjangan wilayah dalam rangka mewujudkan tatanan masyarakat yang aman dan nyaman.

Pada episode kali ini kita akan melihat kerja sama JICA di berbagai sektor yang lansung berkaitan dengan kehidupan masyarakat, seperti pembangunan wilayah, pertanian, pendidikan dan kesehatan, serta program untuk mewujudkan masyarakat dimana semua orang dapat hidup dengan damai.

Selamat menyaksikan dan nantikan episode berikutnya dalam waktu dekat ini!

title: Ep. 2 : Berjalan Bersama sebagai Mitra Penanggulangan Bencana (Bahasa Indonesia)
text:
Ep. 2 : Berjalan Bersama sebagai Mitra Penanggulangan Bencana (Bahasa Indonesia)
Seperti halnya Jepang, Indonesia adalah negara yang rawan dengan berbagai bencana alam. Dibandingkan negara-negara lainnya, Jepang memiliki pemahaman yang lebih terkait penanggulangan bencana. Jepang juga telah menyediakan bantuan terkait kesiapsiagaan bencana dan penanganan darurat serta rekonstruksi pasca bencana di Indonesia.

Pada episode kali ini kita akan melihat lebih dalam lagi tentang bagaimana Indonesia dan Jepang saling bekerjasama dalam menanggulangi bencana.

Nantikan episode berikutnya dalam waktu dekat ini!

title: Ep  1   Indonesia’s Development and Japan’s Cooperation   60 Years and Beyond
text:
Ep  1   Indonesia’s Development and Japan’s Cooperation   60 Years and Beyond
During 60 years of Indonesia-Japan diplomatic relations, Japan has provided a number of technical cooperation projects, ODA loan and grant aid projects for the development of Indonesia, making Japan as the biggest development partner for Indonesia.

In this episode we will look deeper into three aspects, namely history, partnership, and innovation that underlie this strong relation between the two countries.

The next episode is coming soon!

title: Ep. 1 : Pembangunan Indonesia dan Kerjasama Jepang : 60 Tahun dan ke Depannya (Bahasa Indonesia)
text:
Ep. 1 : Pembangunan Indonesia dan Kerjasama Jepang : 60 Tahun dan ke Depannya (Bahasa Indonesia)
Selama 60 tahun hubungan diplomatik Indonesia-Jepang , Jepang telah berkontribusi dalam berbagai program kerjasama pembangunan di berbagai wilayah di Indonesia melalui proyek-proyek kerjasama teknis, pinjaman yen, dan proyek-proyek bantuan hibah, sehingga Jepang menjadi mitra pembangunan terbesar bagi Indonesia.

Dalam episode ini kita akan melihat lebih dalam lagi melalui tiga aspek, yaitu sejarah, kemitraan, dan inovasi, yang mendasari hubungan yang erat antara kedua negara ini.

The following video is the trailer of some of those videos.

title: What We Learned from Tsunami/ Pembelajaran dari Tsunami
text:
What We Learned from Tsunami/ Pembelajaran dari Tsunami
When the tsunami hit the coastal area of Indian Ocean on 2004, many people lost their lives, family members, houses, this tragedy have left a very devastating memory on the people, not just from the residents of the area, but also from people all over the world.

Then on 2015, at the 70th Session of the United Nations General Assembly Plenary Meeting held in New York ‘World Tsunami Awareness Day’ on Nov. 5 was established in order to enhance awareness of tsunami disasters and recognize the significance of preparedness for disasters through early warning system.  
 
To commemorate the establishment of ‘World Tsunami Awareness Day’, JICA in cooperation with the city of Aceh held ‘Aceh Seminar on Tsunami Preparedness on 3-5 Nov 2016. 

=======
Ketika tsunami melanda wilayah pesisir Samudra Hindia  tahun 2004, banyak orang kehilangan nyawa, anggota keluarga dan rumah mereka, tragedi ini telah meninggalkan kenangan buruk bagi banyak orang, tidak hanya penduduk daerah yang terkena bencana, namun juga masyarakat di seluruh dunia.

Kemudian pada tahun 2015, dalam rapat pleno PBB ke-70 di New York , menetapkan tanggal 5 November sebagai 'Hari Kesiapsiagaan Tsunami Dunia', dengan tujuan untuk meningkatkan kesadaran akan bencana tsunami dan pentingnya kesiapan menghadapi bencana melalui sistem peringatan dini.

Untuk memperingati ‘Hari Kesiapsiagaan Tsunami Dunia’, pada 3-5 November 2016, JICA bekerja sama dengan Pemerintah Kota Banda Aceh mengadakan ‘Seminar Aceh tentang Kesiapsiagaan

title: BENTUK CINTA IBU UNTUK SI KECIL
text:
BENTUK CINTA IBU UNTUK SI KECIL
"Buku Kesehatan Ibu dan Anak menunjukkan keinginan kuat seorang ibu untuk memperhatikan kesehatan dan pertumbuhan anaknya. Buku ini mengandung harapan tulus dari seorang ibu agar kehidupan anaknya tidak akan sia-sia, "kata Perdana Menteri Shinzo Abe di pidatonya di Rapat Umum ke- Tujuh Puluh Satu Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa di New York, 29 September 2015. 

Buku KIA yang juga dikenal dengan nama Buku Pink, dikembangkan di Indonesia sejak 1994 atas kerjasama Kementrian Kesehatan RI dan JICA.

Buku ini memiliki dua keistimewaan utama, yakni menjadi satu-satunya alat pencatatan kesehatan Ibu (pada saat hamil, bersalin dan nifas) dan Anak (bayi baru lahir sampai anak usia 6 tahun) yang disimpan di rumah. Serta memuat berbagai informasi cara memelihara dan merawat kesehatan ibu dan anak.

Tidak saja di Indonesia, buku ini juga telah dikembangkan di hampir 40 negara lainnya di dunia dan memiliki satu tujuan utama, yaitu meningkatkan kesehatan ibu dan anak sebagai bagian dari agenda pembangunan berkelanjutan atau SDGs.

title: Let’s Wash Our Hands with HELLO KITTY!! (Hindi Version)
text:
Let’s Wash Our Hands with HELLO KITTY!! (Hindi Version)
Hello Kitty, a world-renowned character, known for her adorable looks and kindness for others, is all set to familiarize children with the importance of handwashing to promote Achhi Aadat (good habits) among children. Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and Japanese entertainment company Sanrio (Sanrio Company, Ltd.) have jointly produced a video in Hindi where Hello Kitty sings a song to promote the correct way of handwashing.

The video is as part of its ongoing “Achhi Aadat” (Good Habit) Campaign launched early this year in India to raise awareness about the importance of hygiene practices for preventing the spread of COVID-19 and other infectious diseases.

title: ЖАЙКА-ийн сайн дурын гишүүн Монголд томилогдсоны 25 жилийн ой "Гэрэлт ирээдүйн төлөө хамтдаа алхая"
text:
ЖАЙКА-ийн сайн дурын гишүүн Монголд томилогдсоны 25 жилийн ой "Гэрэлт ирээдүйн төлөө хамтдаа алхая"
Анх 1992 онд ЖАЙКА-ийн 2 сайн дурын гишүүн Монгол улсад томилогдон ирсэнээс хойш өнөөг хүртэл 647 хүн нийслэл болон хөдөө орон нутагт ажилласан. 
Монгол улсын хөгжлийн төлөө хувь нэмрээ оруулж ирсэн сайн дурын гишүүдийн 25 жилийн түүхэн замналыг өгүүлнэ.

title: Let’s Wash Our Hands with HELLO KITTY!! (English Version)
text:
Let’s Wash Our Hands with HELLO KITTY!! (English Version)
Hello Kitty, a world-renowned character, known for her adorable looks and kindness for others, is all set to familiarize children with the importance of handwashing to promote Achhi Aadat (good habits) among children. title: JICA's Achhi Aadat Campaign
text:
JICA's Achhi Aadat Campaign
JICA India has launched a campaign, “Achhi Aadat” (Good Habit), in India to raise awareness among people about the importance of hygiene practices for preventing the spread of COVID-19 and other infectious diseases. 

In order to introduce diversified people to easy and practical approach to the hygiene and sanitation, we have created an animated version of the educational manga (cartoon) drawn by a well-known manga artist in Japan, Ms. Kimidori Inoue.  The video is dubbed in Hindi by JICA India staff members and edited by JICA Volunteer (JOCV). Through this video, we hope to promote handwashing in a correct way as well as to raise awareness about the importance of hygiene practices. 

You can download and freely utilize the video and take a part in the Achhi Aadat campaign.

title: JICA's Volunteer Activities in India (2017) - Short Version
text:
JICA's Volunteer Activities in India (2017) - Short Version
JICA's volunteer programs support activities by citizens who wish to cooperate in the economic and social development as well as the reconstruction of developing countries. Through these cooperation activities, participating volunteers can not only contribute to the development of partner countries but also gain valuable experience in terms of international goodwill, mutual understanding and an expansion in their international perspectives.
In India, the program started in 1966 and to this date, over 200 volunteers have been dispatched across India, in the field of Education, Community Development, and Sports, etc.  In this video,  2 volunteers of Japanese Language Education and Community Development talk about their activities and their counterparts respectively share their experience of having a volunteer at their places.

title: " Olá! Hello!" Narração de estórias em japonês, português e inglês (Miki Nakamura)
text:
" Olá! Hello!" Narração de estórias em japonês, português e inglês (Miki Nakamura)
“Olá!”
Um gatinho, um cãozinho e um galo vêm até o patinho. Mas o  patinho não entende o que está sendo dito. É um livro ilustrado que mostra a alegria de se comunicar sem as barreiras do idioma.
Este livro foi publicado em 2008, em comemoração ao centenário da imigração japonesa no Brasil.
 
Aproveitem a história em japonês, português ou inglês.
Este vídeo foi criado especialmente para este canal e segue o mesmo formato das sessões de narração de estórias realizadas periodicamente e em formato multilíngue pela biblioteca da JICA Yokohama.
 
_______
"Hello!"
A cat, a dog and a chicken come to  a duck. But the duck doesn't understand what they say. It's a picture book that depicts the joy of being able to communicate as the language barrier disappears.The picture book was published in 2008 to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Japanese immigration to Brazil. The story teller is Ms.Noemia Hinata. Please enjoy in Japanese, Portuguese and English.
 
You can enjoy the multilingual storytelling held regularly at the JICA Yokohama Library in this specially produced video.

title: Handwash actvities with PPAP2020 in Zambia
text:
Handwash actvities with PPAP2020 in Zambia
This video is a 15 minutes-documentary which records handwashing activities organized by JICA Zambia office. PPAP2020, a handwashing song by Japanese comedian Pikotaro, released in April 2020, has been used to encourage the children to wash their hands in a proper and fun way in Lusaka, Zambia. With the cooperation of local NGO and two famous Zambian comedians, JICA sensitized children how to wash their hands properly by performing PPAP2020 with them at assembly halls in two unplanned settlements (compounds) in Lusaka. About 50 children participated in each 30-minute session, and held about 120 sessions in total in the two compounds from October 2020 to February 2021. More than 6,000 children have participated in the activities.

title: NON FORMAL EDUCATION -A Journey of Hope-
text:
NON FORMAL EDUCATION -A Journey of Hope-
In Pakistan, around 22.8 million children are out of school and 60 million young people and adults cannot read or write. These adults and children are unable to get admission in formal schools owing to the age and other circumstances such as social and economic conditions, ethnic and religious differences, and cultural and language barriers. Therefore, they needed alternative and accelerated education system.
JICA's Advancing Quality Alternative Learning Project (AQAL) has provided learning opportunities to out-of-school children, young people and adults through providing Accelerated Learning Program (ALP). In this video you will see how AQAL-ALP attract and motivate not only female and male learners but also parents, community members, and teachers.

title: Trust building is Peace building – a case of social cohesion in Cote d’Ivoire -
text:
Trust building is Peace building – a case of social cohesion in Cote d’Ivoire -
【English】
In Greater Abidjan of Côte d'Ivoire, the conflict of the 2000s led to the destruction of infrastructure and the emergence of political divisions and deteriorating relations between residents.
The technical cooperation project "Project for Community Reinforcement Towards Social Cohesion in Greater Abidjan Phase 2(COSAY2)" is targeting communes that were severely affected by the political crisis, with the aim of establishing methods of public service provision that take into account social integration.

【Français】
Dans le Grand Abidjan de Côte d'Ivoire, le conflit des années 2000 a entraîné la destruction d'infrastructures, l'émergence de clivages politiques et la détérioration des relations entre les habitants.
Le projet de coopération technique "Le Projet de Renforcement des Communes pour la Promotion de la Cohésion Sociale dans le Grand Abidjan Phase 2(COSAY2)" cible les communes qui ont été sévèrement touchées par la crise politique, dans le but d'établir des méthodes de provision de services publics qui tiennent compte de l'intégration sociale.

title: WEAVE YOUR DREAMS
text:
WEAVE YOUR DREAMS
This is a documentary video introducing the success stories of female graduates from three garment related vocational training institutes in Faisalabad and Lahore in Pakistan. It is introduced that female trainees are active in employment, development in career, home-based worker and entrepreneurship after obtaining skills at the training institutes. In addition, the training institutes, families of the females, religious leader, government (Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Textile Division), company and associations deliver positive and hearty messages to encourage women and community to advance female participation in the garment industry as they are convinced that women's participation will contribute to the industrial development. This documentary video will be used as an educational material for female trainee recruitment and employment promotion including home-based worker and entrepreneurship support activities and campaigns at the training institutes. It is expected to raise awareness to transform the mindset of women and community for female technical training and work through the female successful cases and positive messages of the documentary video.
パキスタン国ファイサラバード市、ラホール市の服飾職業訓練校3校の女性卒業生の成功事例紹介のドキュメンタリービデオ。女性訓練生が訓練校で技術を習得後、縫製工場への就職、昇進、家内労働、起業を通じて活躍している姿が紹介されている。更に、各職業訓練校、女性の家族、宗教リーダー、政府（商業省繊維局）、企業、組合が、繊維産業での女性参画が業界全体の発展に寄与するとして、それを後押しするポジティブで力強いメッセージが発せられている。このドキュメンタリービデオは、職業訓練校の女性訓練生募集や就労支援の活動・キャンペーンの啓発教材として活用される。このビデオの事例やメッセージが、女性の職業訓練や就労に対する、現地の女性、その家族、コミュニティのマイン

title: Promotion Video for JICA's "Core Human Resource Development for Road Asset Management Program
text:
Promotion Video for JICA's "Core Human Resource Development for Road Asset Management Program
The Core Human Resource Development for Road Asset Management Program is JICA long-term participants project implemented as part of the RAMP(Road Asset Management Platform) project. One purpose of this project is to deepen understanding of technologies related to road asset management among long term  participants in various countries by providing them with opportunities to acquire knowledge and skills related to these technologies at graduate schools in Japan, and get a first person look at the status of efforts in Japan and the field of human resource development. Another purpose is to contribute to development of human resources who will one day play central roles in road asset management in their home countries by building personal connections with government officials and experts in R&D experts in Japan.

title: JICA President KITAOKA's Video Message for "The India-Japan Forum"
text:
JICA President KITAOKA's Video Message for "The India-Japan Forum"
JICA President KITAOKA delivered a message at the India-Japan Forum organized by the Ministry of External Affairs of the government of India and the Ananta Aspen Center on July 20, 2021.
  In his video message, welcoming the inauguration of a new Japan-India Track-2 dialogue channel, Dr. Kitaoka emphasized the growth of India was essential for the stability and prosperity of the Indo-Pacific region from various point of views including regional security such as "Free and Open Indo-Pacific".  Also he stated about importance of India-Japan development cooperation to achieve "Human security" through the support for the poor and the vulnerable, support for strengthening of the health sector and support for safe water access and hygiene improvement, in order for India to build back better from COVID-19 calamity.  Other issues, such as promotion of Quality Infrastructure and importance of human resource development including exchange of personnel, were addressed as well.

Note: The India-Japan Forum was established as the platform for Track-2 dialogue and the participants are government officials, academia and business executives of both countries.

text:

Este evento fue organizado por la Agencia de Cooperación Internacional de Japón (JICA) y la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores de México.
 
La “Cátedra JICA” es un programa que apoya los estudios sobre Japón en universidades extranjeras.
Japón se ha construido, como una nación, libre, y democrática, pacífica, y próspera, y cimentada en el respeto a la ley, sin perder tradiciones e identidades, así como ha conseguido un alto crecimiento económico a través de una política industrial efectiva y la innovación tecnológica. Con base en nuestra historia reciente, Japón ha acumulado una vasta experiencia en materia de cooperación internacional para el desarrollo. Ejemplo de ello, es la ejecución de la Asistencia Oficial para el Desarrollo en beneficio de países asiáticos que han logrado un notable desarrollo socioeconómico y social en los últimos años. Además, Japón contribuye activamente al desarrollo sostenible en el mundo, encabezando la investigación académica en la materia, así como aprovechando la experiencia y lecciones aprendidas tanto en nuestro propio proceso de modernización como en la larga práctica de cooperación para el desarrollo desplegada en el exterior.

title: Project Activities
text:
Project Activities
Introduction of JICA Technical Cooperation project " the Project for Strengthening the Water Service Management of Pyanj and Khamadoni Vodokanals", which implemented "Handwashing for health and life campaign” in Tajikistan.
This project started in April 2017 and is scheduled to end in June 2021.
In response to the widespread COVID-19, we are practicing to deliver safe water to citizens as tap water, including providing chlorine for disinfection of water supply, which has become difficult to procure.

title: Hand Washing Campaign
text:
Hand Washing Campaign
“Handwashing for health and life campaign” was held as part of the JICA Technical Cooperation project "the Project for Strengthening the Water Service Management of Pyanj and Khamadoni Vodokanals" in Tajikistan. We held a handwashing campaign for for about 1,700 elementary school students from four schools in Pyanj for four days from March 16th to 19th, 2021.
Each child received a pamphlet illustrating the proper way to wash hands, translated into Tajik, and a bar of soap.
We distributed 2,000 bars of soap, including students from the nursing school who taught handwashing and prefectural officials who participated in the campaign.
This video was aired as news in Tajikistan and neighboring countries.

title: BOSAI and Beyond:Building Disaster Resilient Cities -Online Seminar Co-Sponsored with the Inter-ADB-
text:
BOSAI and Beyond:Building Disaster Resilient Cities -Online Seminar Co-Sponsored with the Inter-ADB-
Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) is a disaster-prone region, experiencing numerous earthquakes, floods, landslies, hurricanes, and other natural disasters, similar to Japan. According to the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) the region experienced 4,125 natural disasters between 1980 and 2016, whose economic loss amount to approximately US$282 billion. The LAC region also has a high urbanization rate (over 80% of its population lives in urban areas), and therefore, buildting and maintaining disaster-resilient cities is fundamental to sustainable socio-economic development. In this online-seminar, JICA share experiences in building disaster-resilient cities in Asia, and the City of Sendai shared their experience in rebuilding from the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake. Presenters from Chile and Colombia were invited by the IDB to share their experiences and knowledge on building tsunami-resilient and earthquake resilient cities.

title: Senegal: 40ans de présence permanente du JOCV au Sénégal
text:
Senegal: 40ans de présence permanente du JOCV au Sénégal
En perspective des 60 ans de relations diplomatiques entre le Japon et le Sénégal,il est important de mettre en exergue les 40 années de coopération acquis entre le Japon et le Sénégal à travers le volontariat. En 1980,le gouvernement japonais avait décidé d'envoyer auprès du gouvernement du Sénégal trois (03) jeunes volontaires et ceci après l'accord d'envoi des volontaires signé entre les deux pays en 1979. Depuis lors plus de 1000 volontaires ont servi au Sénégal et font montre d'une excellente coopération avec des compétences avérées dans les domaines de l'éducation, la santé, le développement communautaire, l'agriculture, l'élevage, la formation professionnelle, la pêche, le sport et la protection sociale.Aujourd'hui, nous comptons neuf (09) régions réceptrices et sept (07) secteurs d’activités. 
Les activités des volontaires dans ces domaines ont permis d'améliorer les conditions de vie des populations à travers la production et de la valorisation des ressources agricoles, animales et halieutiques.
 Le Japon, malgré un espace géographique exploitable très limité a atteint aujourd'hui un niveau de développement important. Cela est possible grâce à la motivation, le culte du travail et la loyauté de son peuple. 
Pour tout dire, les nouvelles bases de l’avenir de la coopération à travers la JOCV a comme crédo, travailler et vivre ensemble pour un développement efficient du capital humain.

title: International Day of the Girl Child: Messages from Sakura Girls Secondary School in Tanzania
text:
International Day of the Girl Child: Messages from Sakura Girls Secondary School in Tanzania
In Tanzania, especially in its rural area, it is still very common for schoolgirls to end their education at the primary level, based on the traditional values that “education is not necessary for girls”. In addition, parents decide their marriage in their early teens, and the girls get pregnant and give childbirth soon after, which becomes one of the causes of expansion of poverty with its population growth.

Even in such a society, the girls who can get an opportunity to learn are now having hope for the future and shining toward their dreams, even though their opportunities once have been deprived.

Sakura Girls Secondary School is a boarding school established by Group Kilimanjaro Inc. in 2016. The school educates the next generation’s leaders by providing "student-centered learning", which encourages students to think and act by themselves and develops their independence of mind.

JICA is supporting the operation of Sakura Girls Secondary School through JICA Partnership Program as a model school to provide opportunities for secondary school girls nationwide.

We received messages from the girls who realized that “they don’t have to give up” through all the support for them to have opportunities, hope, and possibilities. They also want to tell their messages to all the women working in the world!

text:
JICA Cooperation in Palau：パラオにおけるJICAの取り組み
The relationship between Palau and Japan is historically strong, and nowadays the two nations have enjoyed close economic relationship through tourism utilising the abundant natural environment in Palau.
However, environmental issues such as management of increasing waste, conservation of the living resources, and countermeasures against climate change are still to be resorved. Moreover, Palau faces developmental difficulties like other small island countries in the Pacific Resion; delay in infrastructure development like energy and water supply, lack of transportation network, limited educational and medical opportunities and insufficient industrial development. 
JICA has been cooperating with Palau for more than 20 years to deal with these issues utilizing technical cooperation, volunteers, grant aid, etc.  In this video,  JICA's latest coopeartions are presented.


日本との歴史的な関わりが深く、また今はその美しい海、珊瑚礁にを楽しみに多くの日本人が訪れているパラオ。一方で、廃棄物対策、生物資源保全や気候変動対応といった環境分野、そしてエネルギー、水供給、交通網、教育や保健、産業振興などの各分野で、小さな島国故に抱えている問題も数多い。このためJICAが国際協力をパラオで展開してきて20年以上が経つ。技術協力、ボランティア、無償資金協力など多岐に渡る取り組みを、特に近年のものにスポットを当てて紹介する。

title: JICA et ville de Yokohama – vers le futur ensemble avec l’Afrique
text:
JICA et ville de Yokohama – vers le futur ensemble avec l’Afrique
Lorsque le port a été ouvert en 1859, Yokohama n’était qu’un village de pêcheurs d’à peine une centaine de foyers. Aujourd’hui, c’est une ville internationale où vivent 3,7 millions de personnes. Précisément parce qu’elle a connu un développement spectaculaire, Yokohama dispose d’un savoir-faire qu’elle peut partager avec les villes africaines qui sont en train de se développer rapidement. Cette vidéo présente les activités de coopération au développement en Afrique réalisé par la JICA et la ville de Yokohama.

title: JICA and the City of Yokohama Into the Future with Africa
text:
JICA and the City of Yokohama Into the Future with Africa
Yokohama was a fishing village with only 100 households when it opened in 1859. Today, it is an international city where 3.7 million people live. Yokohama has undergone remarkable development, so we have the know-how to share with the rapidly growing cities of Africa.
We would like to introduce an example of efforts for international cooperation between JICA and the City of Yokohama in Africa.

title: Video Message for the Virtual High-level Political Forum Side Event
text:
Video Message for the Virtual High-level Political Forum Side Event
On July 13, JICA President Kitaoka delivered a video message for the Virtual High-level Political Forum Side Event titled “From Page to Action: Accountability for the Furthest Left Behind in COVID-19 & Beyond”. He emphasized the importance of human security and also expressed a new initiative with an aim to establish resilient health and medical systems throughout the world.

title: For prosperous future of women:  Case study of three women in Karachi, Pakistan
text:
For prosperous future of women:  Case study of three women in Karachi, Pakistan
This video introduces three cases of women employment: 1)small entrepreneur, 2)factory supervisor and 3) police officer. Three women share her stories such as family, education, job finding, career development, and future perspective. 

JICA implements a technical cooperation project for women home-based workers in Pakistan. As part of project activities, the project is doing awareness raising activities on importance of women employment targeting communities in Karachi, in which the project uses this video to 1) deliver concrete images of working successful women to motivate and inspire young women, and 2) make male family  members realize a variety and possibilities of careers of women.

title: Good Practice for Employing Women:  Case study of Midas Safety, Pakistan
text:
Good Practice for Employing Women:  Case study of Midas Safety, Pakistan
This video introduces a case of Midas Safety to promote women employment in Pakistan by applying good practices such as working place, transportation, and working environment. 

JICA implements a technical cooperation project for women home-based workers in Pakistan. As part of project activities, the project is doing awareness raising activities on importance of women employment targeting communities in Karachi, in which the project uses this video to 1)deliver concrete information on how to enhance female employment by showing good practices of Midas Safety, and 2) deliver concrete information of working places to make family members feel secure about female employment.

title: Prologue to "Seven Chapters on Japanese Modernization"
text:
Prologue to "Seven Chapters on Japanese Modernization"
As part of the JICA Development Studies Program (JICA-DSP), JICA produced a lecture program titled "Seven Chapters on Japanese Modernization" in 2019 in collaboration with the Open University of Japan. This video starts with the interview with the JICA President, Shinichi Kitaoka, on the objectives and outline of the whole series, which is followed by the introduction on the outline of each chapter. It is a good prologue to the seven chapters to learn about Japan and its 150 years of experience in modernization, including its experience as an ODA provider. In addition to the full chapters already on the air on BS231, the OUJ is going to launch the on-line self-learning program of the same subject in August 2020.

title: Iraq Project Series: Spreading Water Users Association for Efficient Use of Irrigation (Overview)
text:
Iraq Project Series: Spreading Water Users Association for Efficient Use of Irrigation (Overview)
Although up to one third of Iraq’s population engages in the agriculture sector, the productivity of agriculture remains low. In order to improve the water resource management and productivity, JICA has provided technical expertise to farmers. They tried the new farming methods and successfully increased the harvest productions and their income. 
Let's check their innovations and achievements.

title: Iraq Project Series: Irrigation Sector Loan (Wasit)
text:
Iraq Project Series: Irrigation Sector Loan (Wasit)
Irrigation Sector Loan

Irrigation Sector Loan Project, together with our counter part Ministry of Water Resources and the partners of the project, enabled agricultural lands in southern Iraq to receive irrigated water which resulted in increased production in crops through rehabilitation of pumping stations and provision of equipment and machineries.

Take a look at the story in Wasit with a beautiful panorama of the farm lands.

title: Iraq Project Series: Hartha Thermal Power Plant Rehabilitation Project (Overview)
text:
Iraq Project Series: Hartha Thermal Power Plant Rehabilitation Project (Overview)
Hartha Thermal Power Plant, the crutial power plant in Basrah Governorate of Southern Iraq, was established in 1982 with the aid from Japan. Subsequently, in order for rehabilitation and upgrade, JICA has extended loan twice for the plant; 
the phase 1 project for rehabilitation of Unit 4, and the phase 2 for refurbishment work of Unit 1 in order for the plant to restore the original output rate of 200MW respectively. 

Take a look at the story of Unit 4 rehabilitation, which was completed in 2017.

title: Iraq Project Series: Electricity Sector Reconstruction Project in Kurdistan Region (Human Element)
text:
Iraq Project Series: Electricity Sector Reconstruction Project in Kurdistan Region (Human Element)
In Iraq, including the Kurdistan Region, has long suffered from the shortage of power supply due to the lack of new investments or management and maintenance of existing facilities. In order to tackle the shortage of electricity infrastructure, the project recovered the electricity network in various locations in the Kurdistan Region through the provision of necessary equipment, rehabilitation of transmission and distributing systems and so forth. The project was successfully completed in 2018.

Let's hear the story of Osta Herish, a local carpenter, talks about how the improved electricity supply helped his business.

Iraq Project Series: Water Supply Improvement Project in Kurdistan Region (Human Element)
In Iraq including the Kurdistan Region, water supply facilities have not been properly rehabilitated or expanded due to the several wars and economic sanctions. As a result, the region had also been suffering from lack of water supply, and water supply had been restricted for only limited hours. This Project improved water supply services in the target cities, by constructing water treatment, transmission and distribution facilities.



Let’s check how people are saved from water scarcity.

title: Iraq Project Series: Port Sector Rehabilitation Project (Human Element)
text:
Iraq Project Series: Port Sector Rehabilitation Project (Human Element)
For Iraq, with a only 48km-long coastal line, the rehabilitation of the major ocean gateways was vital to its national economy. Prior to the project, a majority of cargoes to Iraq had been transported via neighboring countries such as Jordan and Turkey, which resulted in extra time and costs for supplies to be delivered to Iraq.

Let's hear the story of Ahmed Hameed, Manager of a local trader, testifies the improved transportation services through the project.

The Phase II project of the Port Sector Rehabilitation Project focuses on the rehabilitation of Khor Al-Zubair Port which handles heavy and bulk cargoes, aiming to further recover the functions of the Iraqi port system.

title: Iraq Project Series:The Project on Horticulture Technology Improvement and Extension (Human Element)
text:
Iraq Project Series:The Project on Horticulture Technology Improvement and Extension (Human Element)
Development of horticulture would contribute to the economic stability through income generation considering the fact that relatively a high number of farmers are engaged in horticulture in the Kurdistan Region. 

However, productivity and income of horticulture decreased after decades of conflicts and economic sanctions. JICA started technical cooperation, responding to the request from Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG), in order for increase in farmers’ income from horticultural crops through introduction of suitable horticulture technologies and promotion of marketing.

Let’s hear how people's efforts bore the fruits.

text:
Iraq Project Series: Khor Al-Zubair Fertilizer Plant Rehabilitation Project (Human Element)
While the oil industry dominates Iraq’s economy, up to one third of Iraq's population works in the agriculture sector, having the potential to drive economic growth. However, Iraq faces a serious shortage of fertilizer, which is indispensable for improving agricultural production.
JICA, together with Ministry of Industry and Minerals of Iraq, have supported to improve the production capacity of the Khor Al-Zubair Fertilizer plant, thereby contribute to enhance the farmers' accessibility to high quality fertilizers. 
Let's hear the farmer's voice on the Iraqi-locally made fertilizers.

The plant was originally built by a Japanese manufacturer in the 1970s.

Let’s take a look at the 40 years old gigantic fertilizer plant and its resumed operations.

title: Histoire du développement agricole au Japon «5. Amélioration de la nutrition»
text:
Histoire du développement agricole au Japon «5. Amélioration de la nutrition»
En tant qu'agence de mise en œuvre de l'APD (Aide Publique au Développement) au Japon, la JICA (l’Agence Japonaise de Coopération Internationale) a coopéré avec plusieurs pays en développement et possède une longue histoire de coopération, en particulier dans le domaine de l'agriculture, y compris dans le développement des ressources humaines. Cette expérience peut être utilisée comme référence pour le développement agricole dans les pays en développement, c'est pourquoi la JICA a réalisé 5 courtes vidéos intitulées 1. Histoire de l'agriculture japonaise, 2. Développement de la riziculture, 3. Vulgarisation et conseil agricoles, 4. Amélioration des terres agricoles et 5. Amélioration de la nutrition, afin d'introduire systématiquement "L'évolution du développement agricole au Japon". Cette vidéo est l'une d'entre elles, "5. Amélioration de la nutrition". Nous avons également réalisé et publié des versions japonaise et anglaise, il serait donc très apprécié qu'elles puissent être largement utilisées comme outil de développement des ressources humaines dans l'agriculture et que de nombreuses personnes intéressées par l'agriculture japonaise peut regarder cette vidéo.

title: The Evolution of Agricultural Development in Japan“5. Nutrition Improvement”
text:
The Evolution of Agricultural Development in Japan“5. Nutrition Improvement”
As Japan's ODA (Official Development Assistance) implementing agency, JICA (Japan International Cooperation Agency) has been providing various cooperation to developing countries, and has a long history of cooperation especially in the field of agriculture, including human resource development. JICA believes that Japan's experience can be used as a reference for agricultural development in developing countries, therefore JICA made 5 short videos which titled 1. History of Japanese Agriculture, 2. Development of Rice Farming, 3. Agricultural Extension and Support, 4. Land Improvement and 5. Nutrition Improvement, in order to systematically introduce “The Evolution of Agricultural Development in Japan".  This video is one of them,“5. Nutrition Improvement”. We have also made and released Japanese and French versions, so it would be greatly appreciated that thay can be widely used as a tool for human resources development in agriculture and that many people who are interested in Japanese agriculture can watch this video.

title: Grand Egyptian Museum Joint Conservation Project (20 minutes version)
text:
Grand Egyptian Museum Joint Conservation Project (20 minutes version)
Close to the historical pyramids in Giza area lies the construction site of the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). The Museum is constructed with the financial and technical support by Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), and the planned opening is approaching in the fall of 2020!



Along with the museum construction, JICA has also been working with the Conservation Center situated next to GEM over the past decade. The joint activities include the conservation work of the most beautiful artifacts of King Tutankhamun! See the video for details of the "Grand Egyptian Museum Joint Conservation Project (GEM-JC)".

title: Initiative pour la sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle en Afrique (IFNA)
text:
Initiative pour la sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle en Afrique (IFNA)
En 2016, à l'occasion de la TICAD VI, la JICA et AUDA-NEPAD (Agence de développement de l'Union africaine - Nouveau partenariat pour le développement de l'Afrique) ont lancé l'Initiative pour la sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle en Afrique, communément appelée IFNA.　Lors de la TICAD7 de 2019, la "Déclaration de l'IFNA - Yokohama 2019" a été établie pour contribuer à l'amélioration de la nutrition de 200 millions d'enfants en Afrique.

Cette vidéo présente la vue d'ensemble de l'IFNA, des exemples d'activités locales et les perspectives d'avenir.

title: JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines - Agriculture
text:
JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines - Agriculture
With our planet’s daily reminders of climate change and diminishing natural resources, a group of young Japanese volunteers are helping Filipino farmers with thoughtful solutions on how to make their livelihood more sustainable. See how Tadahiro Ikoma, Ayano Yushimura, Koki Itagaki, and Asuka Kunisawa are sharing Japan's experience on sustainable agriculture with local communities.

title: JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines- Disaster Risk Reduction & Management (DRRM)
text:
JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines- Disaster Risk Reduction & Management (DRRM)
Japan is a country known for its disaster risk reduction expertise. They draw from their own experiences dealing with natural disasters and the rich, high-tech technology they developed. But, they are also aware that the people’s own disaster preparedness can help minimize damage. See how young Japanese volunteers Natsuko Kitamura, Kazuyoshi Naito, and Naoaki Tsunoda are helping communities in the Philippines prepare for disasters.

title: JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines- Manufacturing
text:
JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines- Manufacturing
They say an act of compassion can grow into something wonderful. See how young Japanese designers Yuka Ishihara, Midori Morita, and Minato Shiina are doing just that to help students, small enterprises, and women entrepreneurs in designing products for income.

title: For a Brighter Future: Africa's Aims　(Part2)
text:
For a Brighter Future: Africa's Aims　(Part2)
The Japanese government has been leading TICAD (Tokyo International Conference on African Development) since 1993, and this year, the seventh TICAD conference was held from August 28 to 30 in Yokohama, Japan. This program features a panel discussion entitled "Global Governance in Africa and Japan" hosted by JICA as a side event to the TICAD7. 
Up to now, the international community has largely been based on multilateralism and liberalism. However, in recent years, unilateralism and protectionism have made the world significantly more unstable. Africa has achieved remarkable growth in the 21st century. Moving forward, what role should it play in the international community? In addition, what role should Japan play in supporting Africa's development?

【Part1】 
With a population of 1.3 billion, Africa is being called the “last new major market” as it tries to attract private investment from around the world. Part 1 of this program discusses how Africa can increase private investment. And, how to view the relationship between China and Africa, given China’s active investment in Africa.

【Part 2】
What is crucial to Africa’s growth is how to get its 420 million young people to actively participate in the economy. Part 2 of this program discusses what Africa and the rest of the world can do to get youth to participate. And, what Africa should do to achieve the democratic governance that the international community is seeking.

[Panelists]
・Soraya M. Hakuziyaremye, Minister of Trade

title: For our life and future: Refugee Camp Improvement Project in Palestine
text:
For our life and future: Refugee Camp Improvement Project in Palestine
Due to decreasing aid and deteriorating infrastructure, living conditions in Palestinean refugee camps are getting more and more severe and harsh. JICA and PLO-DORA has started “Refugee Camp Improvement Project” (PALCIP) in 3 camps in the West Bank. Each camp organizes a forum where representatives of various categories in the camp (women, youth, seniors and disabled among others) could discuss the problems and the future of the camp and make a concrete Camp Improvement Plan, including vision, strategy and priority actions. PALCIP also organized a mechanism of inducting internal/external funding to realize the Plan by enforcing camp improvement projects based on the needs of the camp. PALCIP provides camp residents an opportunity to engage proactively in improving their life in the camp. In this video, PLO-DORA staff and camp residents reveal the big leap introduced by the Project, and their commitments and hope for the future.
